newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit still at 68 pct power.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit still at 68 pct power.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power plant was still operating at 68 percent after operations were curtailed Wednesday due to problems with a recirculation pump, a spokesman for the plant said Friday.
The problem is expected is take several days to resolve, he added.

The plant, located near Richland, Wash., has been plagued a series of short outages associated with a computerized adjustable speed drive which was installed during a maintenance and refueling outage last spring.
Earlier this month, operations at WNP-2 were reduced during nighttime hours at the request of Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), which markets power produced from the nuclear unit.
But BPA is now indicating "they would be glad to see us at full power," spokesman Richard Romanelli said.
